item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Nov 2
item.description:
The Monday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 2, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; a young pilot named in the Palm Beach County jet crash, staff quit over Haley Stevens' endorsement in Michigan, and the San Juan River crests just short of its 1911 record; Russia resumes attacks on Kherson as the Oleshky truce ends, and Gaza strikes; stocks open higher after a rough October; Tesla's newest Full Self-Driving build draws regression reports; Anthropic's amended IPO filing shows nearly seventeen billion dollars in third-quarter revenue; hackers overheat supermarket freezers across Europe; your X feed; Londonderry's school tax cap question on tomorrow's ballot; and a man who walked home from Chile for 28 years. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday Morning, Nov 2
item.description:
The Monday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 2, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; the final day before the midterms, all nine aboard confirmed dead in the Palm Beach County jet crash, and record flood warnings in southwest Colorado; Iran's two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, Belgium's prime minister offers to resign, and more than 300,000 displaced in Yemen; markets rebound in premarket trading after a rough October; Apple's first earnings under its new CEO; A.I. funding jitters; hacked emergency alert apps in Ukraine and Russia and a Synology NAS ransomware warning; your X feed; New Hampshire's Senate race and Election Day reminders; and volunteers building beds for kids who've never had one. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 4 PM Update, Nov 1
item.description:
The Sunday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 1, 2026: Londonderry conditions through tomorrow afternoon; a business jet bound for the Bahamas crashes in Palm Beach County with nine aboard, and a federal judge tosses the Justice Department's Alaska Senate lawsuit; Iran's Guard says two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz, the U.N. ends its 35-year Western Sahara mission, and Trump and Carney say a Canada trade deal is getting closer; Tesla's latest software update; a shared off switch for A.I. training on websites; a phishing warning from your X feed; a beginner's A.I. night at Leach Library; and a deaf woman's service dog who saved her husband. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 1 PM Update, Nov 1
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
